items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence: nav: `Contracts / HĐ-2026-0187`; h1 `Supply agreement — HĐ-2026-0187` with badge `Active`; secondary line shows exactly four fields: Vendor, Value, Term, Owner.

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: Primary solid button `Request renewal` (bg-blue-700); overflow `#moreBtn` (⋯, aria-haspopup) opens `#moreMenu` containing Download PDF, Duplicate contract, and `Terminate contract` (text-red-700).

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: Nguyễn Văn Hùng / Account Manager with `` and ``, plus `Primary` badge; other two contacts show name/role/mailto/tel without the badge.

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: Table cells use `text-right tabular-nums` and `Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', {style:'currency', currency:'VND'})`, but the `milestones` array order is chronological (Paid, Paid, Overdue, Due soon) — overdue/due-soon rows are not moved to the top.

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: Status cell renders the literal text `Overdue` and `Due soon` inside the colored pill, e.g. `{ name: 'Milestone 3 — Q4 delivery', status: 'Overdue', tone: 'bg-red-50 text-red-800' }`.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: Renewal tab: `Expires in 115 days (28/02/2027)` next to a `Due soon` badge.

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: e.g. `AM-02 — Extended delivery schedule`, `Effective 15/10/2026`, summary paragraph, and `Approved by Lê Thu Hà · 12/10/2026`.

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: No empty/loading/error markup or logic anywhere in the HTML or script — contacts, milestones, and amendments are hard-coded with no alternate states.

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: The `Terminate contract` menu button (line 46) has no click handler in the script — only `#moreBtn` and `.tab-btn` listeners exist — so no confirmation dialog is implemented at all.

notes: Clean, minimal admin-style layout with no obvious template tells (no gradients/glass, no uppercase tracked labels, radii limited to 4/6px, avatars are legitimate person initials for contacts). Audit tool reports score 100/100 with no automated violations. Main gaps are behavioral: milestones aren't reordered to surface overdue/due-soon rows first, and there are no empty/loading/error states or a termination confirmation flow — the Terminate action is inert.
